quests.question: The Eiffel Tower, ___ was completed in 1889, is one of the most visited landmarks in the world.
quests.hint: The Eiffel Tower is already a unique, one-of-a-kind landmark - this clause just adds extra information. Which pronoun is banned from this type of clause?
quests.explanation: Because 'the Eiffel Tower' is already unique, this is a non-defining clause adding extra detail. 'That' cannot be used in non-defining clauses, so 'which' is correct.

quests.question: The photo ___ I took at sunset became my most-liked post ever.
quests.hint: The photo is the OBJECT of 'took' - I took the photo. Which pronoun fits a thing in object position?
quests.explanation: 'Which' refers to a thing in object position. In casual speech this word is often dropped entirely ('The photo I took...'), but 'which' is always a correct, explicit choice.
